Stop trying to wrangle your agents into machines that they don't fit into. Most are forced to choose between speed, persistence, and flexibility. Dedalus Machines gives you all three.

Last week at NY TECH WEEK by a16z , founders and builders filled the room for our BYOA (Bring Your Own Agents) workshop. Everyone brought new ideas and their own agents to showcase and try new tools from us and our partners. Big thank you to our co-host Mercury , and to Sponge (YC W26) and Subconscious for joining us!

NY Tech Week is a wrap! Dedalus closed out the week with Run(way)time, a fashion show celebrating the launch of our merch line and Dedalus Machines. We brought together founders, builders, artists, designers, and investors to explore creative use cases for AI agents while celebrating a staple of dev communities: merch, reimagined through an elevated runway-ready lens. Guests received personal agents through AgentPhone to play a live game, watched our new merch collection on the runway surrounded by visuals from Fuser and other creative technologists, and enjoyed art and music throughout the night. Thank you to everyone for the overwhelming interest and support. We’re grateful to everyone who helped make this event possible!

activity.title: 🥊🤠

Last month, L’Oréal flew me to Paris to pitch a perfume. This month, I created a fragrance line at a infra tech company. Yes, you read that right. Dedalus Labs builds persistent VMs for AI agents, but we believe building a great company is about more than just the product. It’s about creating experiences and communities that people remember. That’s why we’ve never been interested in making the usual startup merch. No generic logo tees. No forgettable swag. If you’ve seen our latest *Automata* merch drop, you probably understand the hype. But for our hand-picked YC Startup School speakeasy guests, we wanted to take it one step further. <<Introducing DEXM>> A limited-edition fragrance collection created exclusively for our DEXM guests. From the scent itself to the bottle, label, and packaging, every detail was intentionally crafted. We wanted to create something that felt thoughtful, refined, and intimate, rather than just another piece of company swag. One thing I learned while in Paris is that scent is uniquely tied to memory. A fragrance can instantly transport you back to a person, place, or moment. It becomes part of your story. As we continue hosting events, we’ll create new scents tied to different milestones in the Dedalus community. - A scent that reminds you of the night you met your cofounder at a mixer. - A scent that brings you back to the workshop where you launched your first agent. - A scent that captures the moment you built something you were proud of. Because the best communities aren’t just built through what you create. They’re built through the moments people remember. DEXM. Made for memories. P.S. you can explore our vault for the full collection: dedaluslabs.ai/store/vault
